description.value:
You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Bypass Cover. Your attack rolls for spells ignore &Reference[halfcover]{Half Cover} and &Reference[threequarterscover]{Three-Quarters Cover}.

Casting in Melee. Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose &Reference[Disadvantage] on your attack rolls with spells.

Increased Range. When you cast a spell that has a range of at least 10 feet and requires you to make an attack roll, you can increase the spell's range by 60 feet.

Foundry Note

The Ability Score Increase is applied by the feat's advancement. Ignoring cover, casting in melee and the increased range are not automated.
